summary: Canada Lookouts lists a Pendleton lookout by region, coordinates and elevation only; a map shows a track named Pendleton Lookout. No source describes a tower.

corrections.why: The Canada Lookouts page title and address say Pendleton, and the map entry is Pendleton Lookout. The heading on the page is misspelled PENDELTON, which the brief copied.

evidence.supports: Pendleton coordinates and elevation on the record
Listed under the British Columbia lookouts heading
Map entry named Pendleton Lookout is a track
evidence.quote: Pendleton Lookout in Area B (Broman Lake/Sheraton) is a track

evidence.supports: Track runs north-south and ends at Augier Road
evidence.quote: It runs in a north-south direction and ends at Augier Road

evidence.supports: The track's other end is a cul-de-sac
evidence.quote: while the other end is a cul-de-sac

evidence.supports: Map lists Pendleton Bay and Babine Lake Campground among nearby features

sources.title: Pendleton Lookout, Area B (Broman Lake/Sheraton) map

notes_for_editor: The only support is the Canada Lookouts entry (coordinates, elevation, region) and a CartoGiraffe map entry for a track named Pendleton Lookout. No year, builder, height, status or staffing was found, so no events or status are given. Searches surfaced a BC Forest Service ranger station at Pendleton Bay and BC Archives photo titles under that name, but the BC Archives page failed with an SSL certificate error and the Lakes District News article returned only the site homepage, so none of it is used. The brief name Pendelton is corrected to Pendleton. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence is that thin.
